name: library-value-classes
prompt: Add three classes in package lib.loan, each in its own file, with final fields, a getter for each field named as the field (book(), not getBook()), and a constructor that takes the fields in the order given: Reservation (Book book, Member member, java.time.LocalDate due), Renewal (Book book, java.time.LocalDate until) and Hold (Member member, Book book, int position).
